events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Tuesday marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years after we lost one of music's most electrifying performers. His legacy truly lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: A timeless classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative today as it did back in '65. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: Wednesday marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who passed away in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Remembering the Starman
angles.copy: Forever a legend. David Bowie would have turned 80 this weekend. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply unparalleled.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Long live The King
angles.copy: On Saturday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92. The King's influence still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and music legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Guitar icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs defined an era.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Rock and Roll Hall of Famer
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Rod Stewart, who turns 82 on Monday! Still got that unmistakable voice and swagger.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's big day
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house of fun.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Timeless vocals
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat'.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 on Wednesday. Her songs and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and pop superstar Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Pop royalty's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get out of our dreams, get into our cars, and turn up his tunes!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Making history
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Take That star's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the brilliant Mark Owen! Still shining brightly.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on this day in 1969 at their Apple Corps headquarters in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Iconic rooftop gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Music legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the phenomenal Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: British acting icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the wonderfully charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to drama, a true British treasure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Pop prince's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo domination, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: British acting legend Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Only Fools and Horses legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable Sir David Jason! A true national treasure.

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: Wednesday marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering a tragic loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, music lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Never gonna give him up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still rocking those hits and that timeless voice.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On Saturday, we remember the iconic Bob Marley, who would have been 82. His message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Songwriting royalty
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! A true songwriting genius who gave us so many timeless classics.

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 Years On
events.blurb: Friday marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston, who died in 2012 at the age of 48.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Remembering Whitney Houston today, whose incredible talent continues to inspire.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Saturday marks the anniversary of the day Take That announced their split in 1996, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: A day pop fans remember
angles.copy: Remembering the day Take That broke millions of hearts by announcing their split. Thankfully, they're 'Still Havin' Fun'.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Reggae royalty's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those smooth reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The Quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who passed away in 2001, would have celebrated his 84th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Remembering the Quiet Beatle
angles.copy: On Thursday, we pay tribute to George Harrison, who would have been 84. His songwriting brought so much beauty to the world.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British 80s pop star Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: 80s pop hero's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! Still 'Wouldn't It Be Good' to hear his hits on repeat.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Coldplay frontman's milestone
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to the incredible Chris Martin! Half a century of life, and still making us believe in 'Magic'.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the one and only Jon Bon Jovi! Still living on a prayer and rocking out.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Chris Rea, who passed away in December 2025, would have celebrated his 76th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Remembering Chris Rea
angles.copy: On Thursday, we remember the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have been 76. His music, like 'Driving Home For Christmas', is truly timeless.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, who passed away in 2021, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Motown legend's tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the elegance and talent of Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 on Saturday. Her voice helped define an era.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut
events.blurb: On Sunday, it's the anniversary of Michael Jackson famously debuting the Moonwalk during his performance of 'Billie Jean' at Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever in 1983.

angles.name: The dance that changed everything
angles.copy: Fifty-four years ago, Michael Jackson moonwalked into history and changed dance forever. What an iconic moment!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Synth-pop legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the groundbreaking Gary Numan! Still influencing artists and sounding wonderfully 'Are 'Friends' Electric?'.
